events.title: Pernod Ricard, Brown-Forman end deal talks
events.body: In a brief statement, the French group said the two spirits giants had been unable to “reach mutually acceptable terms”.

events.title: Brown-Forman Stock Tumbles After Merger Talks for the Jack Daniel’s Owner Collapse
events.body: Brown-Forman, the maker of Jack Daniel’s, and Pernod Ricard fail to reach mutually agreeable merger terms.

events.title: Jack Daniel’s owner ends merger talks with Pernod Ricard
events.body: A combination, which would have created a global spirits giant, broke down after Brown-Forman said it couldn’t come to agreeable terms with the Absolut maker.

events.title: Pernod Ricard Abandons Merger Talks with Brown-Forman
events.body: Pernod Ricard (EU:RI) said it has called off discussions with Brown-Forman (NYSE:BF. A) after the two companies were unable to agree on deal terms.
